idea_summary: A high-end, luxury creative agency-style portfolio website with advanced 3D, GSAP animations, and a custom Next.js/MongoDB CMS dashboard for a designer specializing in Branding, Web/E-commerce, and AI.

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP/ScrollTrigger, Three.js/React Three Fiber
tech_stack.constraints: Strict parallel development workflow required for two developers (Menna and Naira). Each developer owns a full vertical slice (DB -> API -> Dashboard -> UI).

notes: User provided extensive requirements upfront, skipping initial interview questions.
Team consists of Menna and Naira, requiring parallel module-based assignment.
